name: Claude Code

channels.dedupe: gh search issues --repo anthropics/claude-code "<keywords>" across open and closed issues, no label filter; several short phrasings
channels.notes: Blank issues disabled; forms: bug_report, feature_request, model_behavior, documentation, github_connection. A bot flags duplicates and auto-closes them after 3 days.

channels.source: Claude Code built-in command; not re-checked on 2026-10-22
channels.notes: Sends the report with session context straight to Anthropic. No duplicate search and no public link to follow.
Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/responsible-disclosure-policy. Re-read security.txt after its expiry date.
Help and discussion, not a tracker.

rules: Search open and closed issues before filing; comment on a match instead of opening a duplicate.
Use the live issue form for the purpose: bug_report for the tool, model_behavior for what the model said or did, documentation for docs.
Issues filed with gh issue create arrive without the form's label; outside contributors can't set labels.
Never put a security issue on GitHub issues; use the HackerOne route from security.txt.
